responsibility: Defines the per-body `FnCtxt` type-checking context, owning mutable state for return coercions, divergence, breakable scopes, unsafety, and expectation handling while exposing the `AstConv` integration and shared access to inherited inference state for function and closure body checking.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `check/mod.rs`, which wires the overall checking phase and its queries, this `mod.rs` defines the per-body `FnCtxt` state machine used while type-checking a single function/closure/const body. Unlike `astconv/mod.rs`, it is not the generic lowering interface itself, but one concrete `AstConv` implementation that performs inference, records body-local types, and creates obligations during expression checking.
